---
title: ArrayDriver
description: "In-memory cache driver for tests with process-scoped storage and lazy TTL expiry."
---

<ApiBadge type="driver" />
<ApiBadge type="cache" />
<ApiBadge type="in-memory" />
<ApiBadge type="test-only" />

`Skim\Cache\ArrayDriver` stores cache entries in a PHP array. Values exist only for the current process and are never persisted. TTL is enforced via microtime expiry checked lazily on read. This is the default driver for Pest/PHPUnit tests.

```txt
Symbol: Skim\Cache\ArrayDriver
Source: src/Cache/ArrayDriver.php
Lifecycle: process-scoped, resets naturally between requests
Test seam: inject via Cache::setDriver(new ArrayDriver())
```

<CodeExample label="Basic usage" source="llm-generated">
```php
Cache::setDriver(new ArrayDriver());
Cache::set('key', 'value', 60);
// ... run tests ...
Cache::reset();
```
</CodeExample>

<WarningBox>

Not suitable for production — state diverges across PHP-FPM workers

</WarningBox>

## Architecture

Each entry is stored as ['value' =&gt; mixed, 'expires' =&gt; ?float]. The driver is intentionally minimal — it exists to make tests fast and isolated.

<NoteBox>

Why not APCu: APCu state is per-process, inconsistent under PHP-FPM multi-worker. ArrayDriver is the safe alternative for tests.

</NoteBox>

## Read API

<ApiMethod name="get">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
```

</ApiSignature>

Returns the cached value or $default if missing/expired. Delegates to has() for expiry check.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Cache key to read.

</ApiParam>

<ApiParam name="$default" type="mixed">

Fallback returned on miss.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

<ApiMethod name="has">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function has(string $key): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Returns true when the key exists and has not expired. Lazily removes expired keys.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Cache key to test.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

## Write API

<ApiMethod name="set">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function set(string $key, mixed $value, ?int $ttl = null): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Stores value with optional TTL. Null TTL means no expiry. Always returns true.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Cache key to write.

</ApiParam>

<ApiParam name="$value" type="mixed" required>

Payload to persist.

</ApiParam>

<ApiParam name="$ttl" type="?int">

TTL in seconds, or null for no expiry.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

<ApiMethod name="delete">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function delete(string $key): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Removes a single key. No-ops if absent. Always returns true.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Exact cache key to remove.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

## Invalidation

<ApiMethod name="flush">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function flush(string $prefix): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Removes all keys whose name starts with the given prefix.

<ApiParam name="$prefix" type="string" required>

Key prefix to match.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

<ApiMethod name="flushAll">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function flushAll(): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Clears the entire in-memory store.

<WarningBox>

Destroys all cached data in this driver instance

</WarningBox>

</ApiMethod>

## Lifecycle

<ApiMethod name="__construct">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function __construct()
```

</ApiSignature>

Throws if constructed inside a worker process. ArrayDriver stores state in a PHP array, so it leaks across requests in FrankenPHP worker mode.

<ApiThrows type="\RuntimeException">

When WORKER_MODE is defined and true.

</ApiThrows>

<WarningBox>

Use FileDriver or RedisDriver in worker mode instead

</WarningBox>

</ApiMethod>
